Impact Ball didn't deliver his most efficient performance during Friday's season-ending loss, though he did lead the Hornets with 23 points. He also paced the team in assists. The 24-year-old point guard dropped 20-plus points in each of Charlotte's Play-In Tournament games and in 35 of his 72 regular-season appearances (69 starts). Ball took a step back on the offensive end but still averaged at least 20 points per game for a fifth consecutive campaign, finishing the regular season with averages of 20.1 points, 7.1 assists, 4.8 rebounds and 1.2 steals in 28.0 minutes per tilt. 4 DAYS AGO • ROTOWIRE James Harden has the most to lose in the NBA Playoffs, according to Nick Wright 😅 5 DAYS AGO • FOX SPORTS sharefacebookxredditlink How to live stream Hornets vs Magic: NBA play-in tournament, TV channel The Charlotte Hornets and Orlando Magic face off in a win-or-go-home play-in matchup for the Eastern Conference’s final playoff spot.
